title: Porta do Sono — sleeping badly is not normal
metaDesc: Snoring, waking up tired, trouble falling asleep? Four taps, nothing to type — and you know whether to see a doctor, which one in Madeira, and what to tell them. In 5 languages. Free, nothing is stored.
heroTitle: Sleeping badly? Let's see which door to knock on.
heroSub: Four taps, nothing to type. A clear traffic light, the right doctor in Madeira, and a ready phrase to show them — in their language.
introLabel: The first door of the Portas family
introNote: Nothing is stored: your answers stay on your phone.

about.door: Door: four questions by buttons — snoring, daytime sleepiness, blood pressure and weight, age — and a traffic light: fine · worth a visit · don't put it off.
about.show: Show the doctor: a screen in Portuguese with your answers and a ready phrase. Just show your phone — no language barrier.
about.routes: Route: through the SNS (family doctor → specialist) or private care in Madeira — only verified places, with the verification date.
about.private: Private: nothing leaves your phone. No sign-up, no account, no data stored.

disclaimer: This is not medical advice — talk to your doctor.
emergencyLine: Shortness of breath, chest pain or fainting right now — call 112 or SNS 24: 808 24 24 24.
honest: No diagnoses, no percentages, no promises. Only whether it's worth going, to whom, and what to say.
